verdict.rationale: dlt itself is a Python library/CLI with no embedded chat-based AI assistant; instead dltHub ships an 'AI Harness' (skills, rules, MCP servers) that teaches external coding agents like Claude Code, Cursor, or Codex to build and deploy dlt pipelines, and dlt-init-openapi auto-generates pipeline code from specs. This is agent-enabling tooling rather than a built-in assistant users delegate tasks to inside the product itself. Missing for 10: a native, in-product conversational AI assistant/UI for delegating tasks, and evidence of hands-on use of this harness delivering end-to-end task delegation.
